pipeline.name: Verrou d'identité (fortement recommandé)
pipeline.why: Cinq plans générés indépendamment donnent cinq visages différents. Un portrait de référence unique passé à chaque plan tient la continuité.
pipeline.how: generate_image (nano_banana ou seedream) avec le prompt 'character_reference_prompt' ci-dessous, puis passer le job_id résultant à chaque plan vidéo dans medias[] avec role 'image_references', et basculer params.mode sur 'omni_reference'.
pipeline.character_reference_prompt: Editorial portrait photograph of a woman in her early thirties, shoulder-length dark brown hair loosely tied back with a few strands loose, light olive skin, freckles across the nose, no makeup, calm tired expression, wearing a plain oatmeal-coloured ribbed knit sweater. Neutral pale grey seamless background, soft north-facing window light from the left, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. Photorealistic, natural unretouched skin texture with visible pores, no beauty filter, no text, no logos.

params.prompt: Late afternoon in a bright contemporary European apartment kitchen with pale oak cabinets, a neutral stone worktop and a large window with sheer curtains. A woman in her early thirties, shoulder-length dark brown hair loosely tied back, light olive skin, freckles, no makeup, wearing a plain oatmeal-coloured ribbed knit sweater, finishes a plate of food at the counter. She sets her fork down, leans back and rubs the back of her neck, exhaling. She is not ill, she is depleted. Warm low backlight through the window, visible dust in the light beam. Camera performs a slow steady push-in on her face, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, handheld with almost no movement. Naturalistic warm daylight grade, soft contrast, gentle film grain, no teal-and-orange look. No phone in frame. The scene is calm and unhurried. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or captions anywhere in the frame. Photorealistic, natural unretouched skin texture, no beauty filter, no slow-motion, no lens flare.

Same late-afternoon kitchen, same woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length dark brown hair loosely tied back and an oatmeal-coloured knit sweater. She reaches across the stone worktop and picks up a modern black smartphone lying face down. She turns it over and the screen wakes, casting a soft cool green glow across her fingers and the underside of her chin. Camera glides from behind her right shoulder and settles into a clean flat over-the-shoulder framing on the phone held in her hands, the phone occupying the central third of the vertical frame. 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, the kitchen falling out of focus behind. Naturalistic warm daylight grade with the cool screen glow as the only cold light. The phone screen shows only a soft featureless neutral glow — no readable interface, no app UI, no icons. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or captions anywhere in the frame. Photorealistic, natural unretouched skin texture, no beauty filter.

Fast three-part montage in the same bright kitchen, same woman with shoulder-length dark brown hair and oatmeal knit sweater. First beat: tight close-up of her hands holding a modern black smartphone near her mouth as she speaks a short sentence into it, her lips clearly moving, relaxed and casual. Second beat: macro shot of her thumb tapping once decisively on the lower part of the phone screen. Third beat: crisp overhead top-down shot of a real meal on the stone worktop, a bowl of white rice, two soft-boiled eggs cut open and a handful of wilted spinach, steam rising. Hard cuts between the three beats, a quick whip-pan between the first and the second. 50mm macro feel on the food shot, shallow depth of field throughout. Bright even daylight, naturalistic warm grade, gentle film grain. The phone screen shows only a soft featureless neutral glow — no readable interface, no app UI, no icons. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or captions anywhere in the frame. Photorealistic, natural unretouched skin texture.
